scope: analysis only: the units, the replay, the identity, the merge, the measures, the hypotheses, and the registered checks are unchanged and decide as registered; two analyses are reported beside them

observation.C32: C32 compares each replay's expanded states, by faithful keys, with keys-v0.1's log of the unit. keys-v0.1 exported through a run_tac block, which failed on every expanded state of 10 of the 426 units it recorded among this run's (139 states): the step-prover units of MvPolynomial.pow_idealOfVars and MvPolynomial.coeff_add_pow, and the menu units of Polynomial.leadingCoeff_add_of_degree_eq, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_monic_mul, Polynomial.degree_le_mul_left, Polynomial.nextCoeff_X_sub_C, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_X_sub_C, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, Polynomial.degree_lt_degree, and Polynomial.natDegree_mul_X. This run exports through tactics defined right after the imports, which search-v0.8 introduced because of that failure; where its export succeeds, the registered C32 counts the unit as differing although there is no key to compare it with. Ten units are 2.3% of 426, more than the 2% C32 allows: run on keys-v0.1's own logs with keys filled in for those states, the registered check finds 416 of 426 replays matching, short of the 418 it needs, while every replay matches on the states keys-v0.1 keyed.
observation.H93: The preregistration's cost measure is the time of the instances-transparency merge, 'hashing and isDefEq, not elaboration of the printed types'. In the registered code (goal_defeq.DEFEQ_TEMPLATE) each goal is hashed in the loop that elaborates it, so its hashing is timed with its elaboration (elabNanos, summed as elabSeconds), and the merge time is the bucket lookups and the isDefEq checks.
observation.docstrings: The docstrings of goal_defeq.py (the module's and canonical_classes') say that the merge runs at reducible and instances transparency and that an entry has pp and levels; the registered code runs at reducible, instances, and default transparency, as the preregistration states, and also reads each entry's number of hypotheses. The file is kept as registered.

change: scripts/defeq_v01_amendment.py reports, beside the registered decisions: (1) C32 over the states keys-v0.1 keyed: a unit matches when it reaches keys-v0.1's outcome, expands as many states, and every expanded state that keys-v0.1 keyed has the same faithful key in the replay, a state keys-v0.1 did not key being left uncompared, with C32's threshold of 98%; and the units the registered check counts as differing, split into those that differ only at states keys-v0.1 did not key and the others. (2) For H93, each unit's ratio with the elaboration and hashing time of the printed types added to the merge time, and its median in each set of units against the same 1%; it bounds the ratio the preregistration describes from above. The registered C32 and H93 are computed, reported, and decided as registered. The analyses are written to amendment-1-results.json from the committed results after the run, and CI recomputes them.
resultsSeenBeforeAmendment: the runner's progress lines of the units finished so far (per unit: the outcome, the number of distinct goals, whether the merge completed) and the first four rows in full (construction, outcome, export counts, states, distinct goals, times); no measure, share, merge class, check, cost ratio, or hypothesis was computed. The ten units were found in keys-v0.1's committed logs, and the arithmetic above comes from those logs alone
